title: 4946七成吸取汲取按敌最大HP理论回复，Q-LIGHT-009转真后穿全免且禁疗倍率独立
block: test('4946七成吸取汲取按敌最大HP理论回复，Q-LIGHT-009转真后穿全免且禁疗倍率独立',()=>{for(const mode of ['normal','percent-immune','all-immune','skill-ban','half-heal','zero-heal']){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,bStats:{maxHp:3000},targetHp:1000});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='percent-immune'||mode==='all-immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='all-immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='half-heal'||mode==='zero-heal')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:mode==='half-heal'?.5:1});turn(s,38536,20309);const f=s.fighters[0],result=f.soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain;assert.equal(result.requested,2100);assert.equal(result.basis,'maxHp');assert.equal(result.type,['percent-immune','all-immune'].includes(mode)?'true':'percent');assert.equal(f.hp,mode==='zero-heal'?4500:mode==='half-heal'?5550:6600);assert.equal(result.settledDamage,2100);assert.ok(result.hpLoss<2100);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);if(mode==='all-immune')assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),2100);}});

title: 完整结算：固定伤害先经过减免护罩再记录，免疫不扣血
block: test('完整结算：固定伤害先经过减免护罩再记录，免疫不扣血',()=>{for(const immune of [false,true]){let s=game(snap(99653,null,[[29,[800]]]),snap(99654),[{overrides:{maxHp:2000,spe:900}},{overrides:{maxHp:2000},resistance:{fixed:50}}]);s.fighters[1].hp=100;s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=100;if(immune)s.fighters[1].effects['当回合免伤']={start:1,end:1};s=E.resolveTurn(s,[key(99653,1),key(99654,1)]);if(immune){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,100);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).length,0);}else{assert.equal(s.damageEvents[0].settledDamage,300);assert.equal(s.damageEvents[0].hpLoss,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,0);}}});

title: Q-DAMAGE-001：免疫和完全抵挡不触发正伤害事件，明确限伤保留其数值
block: test('Q-DAMAGE-001：免疫和完全抵挡不触发正伤害事件，明确限伤保留其数值',()=>{for(const mode of ['immune','barrier','shield','cap']){let s=game(snap(99674,null,[[29,[800]]]),snap(99675,611),[{overrides:{maxHp:2000,spe:900}},{overrides:{maxHp:1000}}]);s.fighters[1].hp=1;s.fighters[1].effects['大伤回满']={start:1,end:1,threshold:300};if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].effects['当回合免伤']={start:1,end:1};if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=800;if(mode==='barrier')s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=800;if(mode==='cap')s.fighters[1].effects['伤害上限']={start:1,end:1,amount:100};s=E.resolveTurn(s,[key(99674,1),key(99675,2)]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,mode==='shield'?1000:1);assert.equal(s.damageEvents?.[0]?.settledDamage??0,mode==='cap'?100:mode==='shield'?800:0);assert.equal(s.damageEvents?.[0]?.hpLoss??0,0);assert.equal(s.turns[0].events.some(x=>x.text.includes('大伤回满：')),mode==='shield');if(mode==='shield')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,800);}});

title: 3964魂印高体攻击命中即害怕，MISS不施加，免伤零伤命中仍施加
block: test('3964魂印高体攻击命中即害怕，MISS不施加，免伤零伤命中仍施加',()=>{for(const mode of ['normal','immune','miss']){let s=make({moveId:10001,index:null},{soul:1229,hp:8000,targetHp:6000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'当回合免伤');if(mode==='miss'){s.moveDefinitions[key(900040)].alwaysHit=false;s.moveDefinitions[key(900040)].accuracy=0;}const o=turn(s,900031,900040);assert.equal(!!o.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],mode!=='miss');}});

title: 3983确认2368多段仅消费一次且免伤仍消费，替换机会到零后结束
block: test('3983确认2368多段仅消费一次且免伤仍消费，替换机会到零后结束',()=>{let o=turn(make(pick(2368)[0]));const r=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[31],x=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances([{id:31,args:[2,2],description:r.template}],[{id:31,argsNum:r.argsNum,template:r.template}],{id:900030,name:'双段替换',kind:'special',power:100});o.moveDefinitions[key(900030)].operations=x.operations;o=turn(o,900030);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].counts.chenDefenseReplace,1);assert.equal(o.turns.at(-1).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='damage'&&e.damage?.type==='attack').length,2);timer(o,1,'当回合免伤');o=turn(o,900030);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].counts.chenDefenseReplace,0);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].lastSettledAttackDamage,0);assert.ok(o.fighters[1].ailments['石化']);});

title: 3986 Q-LIGHT-009覆盖旧1533真伤免疫确认，350真伤穿全免且MISS不触发
block: test('3986 Q-LIGHT-009覆盖旧1533真伤免疫确认，350真伤穿全免且MISS不触发',()=>{let s=make(pick(1533)[0],{hit:false});delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].alwaysHit=false;s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].accuracy=0;assert.equal((turn(s).damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='true').length,0);s=make(pick(1533)[0]);s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].power=0;timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,8650);assert.equal(o.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='true').settledDamage,350);});

4186 1672出手未满血固定吸取200按理论回复、满体不吸及百分比免疫不混同

4222 1693条件免疫1018和群星逆转均触发额外真伤，百分比全减免/臣服/保留1HP实际零损失不冒充免疫
block:
test('4222 1693条件免疫1018和群星逆转均触发额外真伤，百分比全减免/臣服/保留1HP实际零损失不冒充免疫',()=>{const s=make(pick(1693)[0]);timer(s,1,'低伤免疫返还',{threshold:3001});const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,5700);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.deepEqual(o.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='fixed'&&e.targetSide===0).map(e=>e.settledDamage),[3000,300]);const v=require('../local-species.cjs').species(4048);for(const soul of v.souls){const z=make(pick(1693)[0],{enemySoul:soul,targetHp:2000}),p=turn(z);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].hp,6200);assert.equal(p.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='true'&&e.targetSide===1).settledDamage,300);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].soulState.illusionReverseUsed,true);}const reduce=make(pick(1693)[0]);timer(reduce,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:1});const r=turn(reduce);assert.equal(r.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal(r.damageEvents?.some(e=>e.type==='true')??false,false);const floor=make(pick(1693)[0],{targetHp:1});timer(floor,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});const f=turn(floor);assert.equal(f.fighters[1].hp,1);assert.equal(f.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent').settledDamage,3000);assert.equal(f.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent').hpLoss,0);assert.equal(f.damageEvents.some(e=>e.type==='true'),false);const subdued=make(pick(1693)[0]);subdued.fighters[0].ailments['臣服']=3;const n=turn(subdued);assert.equal(n.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal(n.damageEvents?.some(e=>e.type==='true')??false,false);});

{const test=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');

title: 4239 2282静态免粉独立补25%真伤含零回复，实际条件免疫补真，盾挡/全减免不补且每招仅一次
block: test('4239 2282静态免粉独立补25%真伤含零回复，实际条件免疫补真，盾挡/全减免不补且每招仅一次',()=>{for(const mode of ['immune','full-immune','ban-immune','shield','reduction','conditional']){const s=make(pick(2282)[0],{hp:mode==='full-immune'?9000:1000});if(mode.includes('immune'))timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='ban-immune')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=4000;if(mode==='reduction')timer(s,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:1});if(mode==='conditional')timer(s,1,'低伤免疫返还',{threshold:3001});const o=turn(s);if(mode.includes('immune'))assert.equal(sum(o,'true'),2250);else if(mode==='conditional')assert.deepEqual(ev(o,'fixed',0).map(e=>e.settledDamage),[3000,2250]);else assert.equal(sum(o,'true'),0);}let s=turn(make(pick(2282)[0],{hp:1000}));s.fighters[0].hp=1000;const m=s.moveDefinitions[key(920030)],r=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[31],c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances([{id:31,args:[3,3],description:r.template}],[{id:31,argsNum:2,template:r.template}],m);m.operations=c.operations;const o=turn(s,920030);assert.equal(ev(o,'attack').length,3);assert.equal(ev(o,'percent').filter(e=>e.round===o.round-1).reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),3000);});

title: 4264 1720按残存护盾50%真伤，护罩不算盾，无盾无追加，Q-LIGHT-009全免不挡真伤
block: test('4264 1720按残存护盾50%真伤，护罩不算盾，无盾无追加，Q-LIGHT-009全免不挡真伤',()=>{for(const mode of ['shield','barrier','none','immune']){const s=make(pick(1720)[0]);if(mode==='shield'||mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=1000;if(mode==='barrier')s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=1000;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');const baseline=structuredClone(s);baseline.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].operations=[];const z=turn(baseline),o=turn(s),remaining=z.fighters[1].suitState.shield;assert.equal(sum(o,'true'),['shield','immune'].includes(mode)?Math.floor(remaining*.5):0);if(mode==='barrier')assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,z.fighters[1].hp);}});

title: 4327 Q092粉免优先且每次只消费一份，Q-LIGHT-009真正免粉后的2250补真穿全免
block: test('4327 Q092粉免优先且每次只消费一份，Q-LIGHT-009真正免粉后的2250补真穿全免',()=>{for(const mode of ['immune','reduction','reflect']){const s=make(pick(1770)[0]);let o=turn(s,s.auditMoveId,920040);if(mode==='immune')timer(o,0,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='reduction'){o.fighters[0].counts.nextPinkReduction=1;o.fighters[0].soulState.nextPinkReductionFraction=1;}if(mode==='reflect')timer(o,0,'当回合免伤');H.op(o,1697,[25]);const z=turn(o,920031,920042);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].soulState.war1770Pink,0);assert.equal(sum(z,'percent',0),0);if(mode==='reduction')assert.equal(z.fighters[0].counts.nextPinkReduction,1);assert.equal(sum(z,'true',0),2250);}});

title: 4354真实2354理论250回复及完整真伤，Q-LIGHT-009穿全免而护盾禁疗上限独立
block: test('4354真实2354理论250回复及完整真伤，Q-LIGHT-009穿全免而护盾禁疗上限独立',()=>{for(const hp of [1,200,250]){const s=make(pick(2354)[0],{hp:1000,targetHp:hp});s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].power=0;const o=turn(s);assert.equal(sum(o,'true',1),250);assert.equal(ev(o,'true',1)[0].hpLoss,hp);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,1250);}for(const mode of ['shield','blocked','cap','multiplier','wholeImmune']){const s=make(pick(2354)[0],{hp:mode==='cap'?8900:1000});s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].power=0;if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=500;if(mode==='blocked')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='multiplier')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='wholeImmune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,mode==='blocked'?1000:mode==='cap'?9000:mode==='multiplier'?1125:1250);if(mode==='shield'){assert.equal(o.fighters[1].suitState.shield,500);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,8750);}if(mode==='wholeImmune')assert.equal(sum(o,'true',1),250);}});

title: 4408 479自身损失穿普通盾/伤免且不受禁疗伪成回复，500原量固定受免疫但自损不免
block: test('4408 479自身损失穿普通盾/伤免且不受禁疗伪成回复，500原量固定受免疫但自损不免',()=>{const s=make(pick(479)[0],{hp:700});s.fighters[0].suitState.shield=1000;s.fighters[0].suitState.barrier=1000;timer(s,0,'当回合免伤');timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,200);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].suitState.shield,1000);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,1000);assert.equal(sum(o,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(o.healthLossEvents.find(x=>x.targetSide===0).hpLoss,500);});

title: 4432 1187诅咒失败清回合和免疫，1276消耗是直接HP损失非伤害、追加实际消耗一半粉伤并允许同归
block: test('4432 1187诅咒失败清回合和免疫，1276消耗是直接HP损失非伤害、追加实际消耗一半粉伤并允许同归',()=>{for(const immune of [false,true]){const s=make(pick(1187)[0]);if(immune)timer(s,1,'免异常');timer(s,1,'测试回合');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(!!o.fighters[1].ailments['诅咒'],!immune);assert.equal(!!o.fighters[1].effects['测试回合'],!immune);}const s=make(pick(1276)[0],{hp:1000,targetHp:400});s.fighters[0].suitState.shield=1000;timer(s,0,'当回合免伤');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(sum(o,'percent'),500);assert.equal((o.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.targetSide===0).length,0);assert.equal(o.healthLossEvents[0].hpLoss,1000);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].suitState.shield,1000);});

title: 4432 1418直接HP损失200穿盾不作伤害事件，1750负级视图不改原值，1115解弱成功才下次攻无效，572毒才诅咒
block: test('4432 1418直接HP损失200穿盾不作伤害事件，1750负级视图不改原值，1115解弱成功才下次攻无效，572毒才诅咒',()=>{const s=make(pick(1418)[0],{hp:1000});s.fighters[0].suitState.shield=1000;timer(s,0,'当回合免伤');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,800);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].suitState.shield,1000);assert.equal(o.healthLossEvents[0].hpLoss,200);assert.equal(ev(o,'true',0).length,0);const a=make(pick(1750)[0]);a.fighters[0].stages.spa=-2;const b=make(pick(1750)[0],{omit:true});assert.equal(sum(turn(a)),sum(turn(b)));assert.equal(turn(a).fighters[0].stages.spa,-2);for(const neg of [false,true]){const q=make(pick(1115)[0]);if(neg)q.fighters[0].stages.atk=-1;assert.equal(turn(q).fighters[1].counts.nextAttackInvalid??0,neg?1:0);}for(const poison of [false,true]){const q=make(pick(572)[0]);if(poison)q.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;assert.equal(!!turn(q).fighters[1].ailments['诅咒'],poison);}});

title: 4444 reductions ignored independently; Q-LIGHT-009 true bypasses immunity while fixed/percent immunity and barriers remain
4450再现的已知属性后PP分支独立真实其他技能回1受禁回PP，攻击再现50%独立乘数；未解析真伤被免仍按已答理论300回复
block: test('4450再现的已知属性后PP分支独立真实其他技能回1受禁回PP，攻击再现50%独立乘数；未解析真伤被免仍按已答理论300回复',()=>{for(const ban of [false,true]){const s=make(pick(1894)[0]);s.fighters[0].soulState.futureParsedMove={id:key(920041)};s.moveDefinitions[key(36303)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(36303)].operations.filter(o=>o.phase==='afterUse');s.fighters[0].pp[key(920031)]=90;if(ban){s.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;timer(s,1,'机械领域',{fraction:.4});}const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(920031)],ban?90:91);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(36303)],0);}const s=make(pick(1894)[0],{hp:1000});timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingReplayFallbackHeal,undefined);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,1300);const a=make(pick(1894)[0]),b=structuredClone(a);for(const x of [a,b])x.moveDefinitions[key(36303)].operations=x.moveDefinitions[key(36303)].operations.filter(o=>o.phase==='beforeDamage');a.moveDefinitions[key(36303)].reproducedParsedAttack=true;assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(turn(a))-sum(turn(b))*1.5)<3);});

title: 4450 1894理论300回复及残血保1禁疗倍率封顶，Q-LIGHT-009全免不挡真伤而减伤独立
block: test('4450 1894理论300回复及残血保1禁疗倍率封顶，Q-LIGHT-009全免不挡真伤而减伤独立',()=>{for(const mode of ['ordinary','low','floor','immune','halfDamage','ban','halfHeal','cap'])for(const same of [false,true]){const s=make(pick(1894)[0],{hp:mode==='cap'?8900:1000,targetHp:['low','floor'].includes(mode)?1:9000});if(same)s.fighters[0].soulState.futureParsedMove={id:key(36303),name:s.moveDefinitions[key(36303)].name};if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');if(mode==='halfDamage')timer(s,1,'全伤害减半');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='halfHeal')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?1000:mode==='halfHeal'?1150:mode==='cap'?9000:1300);assert.equal(fixed(o),mode==='halfDamage'?150:300);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].soulState.pendingReplayFallbackHeal,undefined);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(36303)],0);if(mode==='floor'){const e=o.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='true');assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);assert.equal(e.settledDamage,300);}}});

title: 4450 1889命中封锁不触发补偿，正常命中不虚加400且错误来源/index/参数拒绝
block:
test('4450 1889命中封锁不触发补偿，正常命中不虚加400且错误来源/index/参数拒绝',()=>{const s=make(pick(1889)[0]);const normal=turn(s);assert.equal(fixed(normal),0);assert.ok(normal.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫']);const immune=make(pick(1889)[0]);timer(immune,0,'技能命中效果失效');timer(immune,1,'当回合免伤');assert.equal(fixed(turn(immune)),0);const r=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[1889],m=H.source.moves.find(m=>m.id===28166);for(const [move,index,params]of [[{...m,hash:'bad'},1,[100,7,200]],[m,0,[100,7,200]],[m,1,[100,7,201]]])assert.throws(()=>r.validate(params,move,index),/精确来源/);});

function realParsed(s,id){const raw=H.source.moves.find(m=>m.id===id);s.moveDefinitions[key(id)]={...s.moveDefinitions[key(920040)],id:key(id),wikiId:id,name:raw.name,kind:raw.kind,type:raw.kind==='status'?'属性':raw.type,power:raw.power,accuracy:raw.accuracy,alwaysHit:raw.alwaysHit,priority:raw.priority,pp:raw.pp,revision:raw.revision,fifth:raw.fifth,operations:H.independentOperations(raw)};s.fighters[0].soulState.futureParsedMove={id:key(id)};return s.moveDefinitions[key(id)];}

title: 4450实际一次再现攻击的上次伤害记录合计复制多段及自身段，完整红伤与HP损失独立
block: test('4450实际一次再现攻击的上次伤害记录合计复制多段及自身段，完整红伤与HP损失独立',()=>{for(const mode of ['plain','floor','shield','immune']){const s=make(pick(1894)[0],{targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:9000});realParsed(s,36298);s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫']=99;if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=9000;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');const o=turn(s),events=o.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===1&&e.type==='attack');assert.ok(events.length>=3);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].lastSettledAttackDamage,events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),mode);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].lastAttackDamage,events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.hpLoss,0),mode);if(mode==='floor'){assert.ok(o.fighters[0].lastSettledAttackDamage>0);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].lastAttackDamage,0);}}});

title: 4482 587 true500 keeps complete damage and HP floor1; Q-LIGHT-009 bypasses all immunity and shield behavior stays unchanged
block: test('4482 587 true500 keeps complete damage and HP floor1; Q-LIGHT-009 bypasses all immunity and shield behavior stays unchanged',()=>{for(const mode of ['normal','low','one','shield','immune','suppressed']){let s=turn(make(pick(587)[0],{hp:100}));const target=s.fighters[1];if(mode==='low')target.hp=200;if(mode==='one')target.hp=1;if(mode==='shield')shields.add(target,1000,'587-true-shield');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');if(mode==='suppressed')s.fighters[0].soulState.defeatEffectsSuppressed=true;const before=target.hp;timer(s,1,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:500});const o=turn(s,920031,920040),e=events(o,'true',1);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].hp,0);if(mode==='suppressed'){assert.equal(e.length,0);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,before);if(mode==='immune')assert.equal(o.fighters[0].effects['击败反击保留1'],undefined);}else{assert.equal(e.length,1);assert.equal(e[0].settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e[0].hpLoss,Math.min(before-1,500));assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,Math.max(1,before-500));assert.equal(o.fighters[0].effects['击败反击保留1'],undefined);}if(mode==='shield')assert.equal(o.fighters[1].suitState.shield,1000);}});

title: 4482 62 binds both sides;clear either cancels immediately,clear protection retains binding;execution only responds to death prevention
block: test('4482 62 binds both sides;clear either cancels immediately,clear protection retains binding;execution only responds to death prevention',()=>{for(const mode of ['none','selfClear','targetClear','protected','floor','shieldImmune']){let s=turn(make(pick(62)[0]));const initialTargetHp=s.fighters[1].hp,token=s.fighters[0].effects['延迟决胜'].delayedExecutionToken;assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['延迟决胜绑定'].delayedExecutionToken,token);if(['selfClear','protected'].includes(mode)){if(mode==='protected')timer(s,0,'protect');H.op(s,1254,[],920042);s.moveDefinitions[key(920042)].priority=4;s=turn(s,920031,920042);}if(mode==='targetClear'){H.op(s,1254,[],920031);s=turn(s,920031,920041);}if(['selfClear','targetClear'].includes(mode))for(const f of s.fighters)assert.ok(!Object.values(f.effects).some(e=>e.delayedExecutionToken===token));if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='shieldImmune'){shields.add(s.fighters[1],10000,'62-execution');timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');}while(s.round<=6&&!s.finished)s=turn(s,920032,920041);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,mode==='floor'?1:['selfClear','targetClear'].includes(mode)?initialTargetHp:0,mode);const deaths=(s.healthLossEvents??[]).filter(x=>x.type==='execution'&&x.targetSide===1);assert.equal(deaths.length,['selfClear','targetClear'].includes(mode)?0:1);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(x=>x.type!=='attack').length,0);}});
